blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makati City Regional Trial Court has ordered the arrest of Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste for allegedly violating the Public Service Act. The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) confirmed the arrest warrant to reporters on Wednesday morning and provided a copy of the document. The warrant set Leviste’s bail at P72,000. READ: Trafficking raps vs Leviste, 6 others move from NBI to DOJ The NBI has yet to provide further details about the case. Leviste was reportedly in France with his mother, Sen.
